description: Authoritative catalog of Playdate SDK features the autopilot may emit into scene Lua. Snippets concatenate by slot via buildSceneLuaFromFeatures(). All APIs verified against Playdate SDK 3.0.6.

features.name: Button just-pressed edge
features.when_to_use: Fire once on the frame a button transitions down. Use for confirm, jump, attack, dialog advance — anything that should NOT repeat while held.

features.name: Button just-released edge
features.when_to_use: Fire once on the frame a button is released. Use for charged shots, tap-vs-hold disambiguation, releasing a grabbed object.

features.name: Button held this frame
features.when_to_use: Continuous input each frame: movement, hold-to-charge, scroll. NOT for menu confirm (use edge).

snippets.update_tick:
if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonRight) then state.x = state.x + 2 end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonLeft)  then state.x = state.x - 2 end

features.name: Global button callbacks
features.when_to_use: Override playdate.AButtonDown / BButtonDown / upButtonDown etc when you want event-style handlers instead of polling.

snippets.input_bindings:
function playdate.AButtonDown() state.confirm() end
function playdate.BButtonDown() state.back() end

features.name: D-pad menu navigation
features.when_to_use: Cursor movement through a list / grid. Pair with A-confirm. Provide as fallback when crank also navigates.

snippets.update_tick:
if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonDown) then
        state.cursor = math.min(state.cursor + 1, #state.items)
    elseif playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonUp) then
        state.cursor = math.max(state.cursor - 1, 1)
    end

features.name: Crank delta (degrees this frame)
features.when_to_use: Smooth analog rotation: dials, vehicle steering, reel-in. Returns degrees change since last frame plus acceleration factor.

snippets.update_tick:
local change, accel = playdate.getCrankChange()
    state.angle = state.angle + change

features.name: Crank discrete tick reader
features.when_to_use: Step through discrete options. Use for menus, dialog choices, character creator categories. Pass ticks-per-revolution.

snippets.update_tick:
local ticks = playdate.getCrankTicks(12)
    if ticks ~= 0 then
        state.choice = ((state.choice - 1 + ticks) % #state.options + #state.options) % #state.options + 1
    end

features.name: Crank absolute position
features.when_to_use: Use when the crank's absolute angle maps to game state (a dial pointer, a year/date scrubber). NOT for incremental input.

features.name: Crank docked state
features.when_to_use: Detect whether the crank is folded into the device. Pause crank gameplay or show the crank-out prompt when docked.

features.name: Crank-out indicator overlay
features.when_to_use: Standard Panic UI that prompts the player to extend the crank. Required UX when crank input is essential and the crank is docked.

features.name: playdate.cranked callback
features.when_to_use: Event-style crank handler. Fires every frame the crank moves. Use when scene wants to react to crank without polling in update.

features.name: Accelerometer 3-axis read
features.when_to_use: Tilt-based steering, shake gestures, balance puzzles. MUST start the peripheral first. Cannot detect rotation when flat.
features.example_lua: playdate.startAccelerometer(); local x, y, z = playdate.readAccelerometer()

snippets.update_tick:
local ax, ay, az = playdate.readAccelerometer()
    state.tilt_x, state.tilt_y = ax, ay

features.name: Onscreen keyboard text entry
features.when_to_use: Short text entry only (player name, save label). Reconsider design if lots of text needed.

snippets.setup:
playdate.keyboard.keyboardWillHideCallback = function(ok)
        if ok then state.name = playdate.keyboard.text end
    end

features.name: Clear screen each frame
features.when_to_use: Start of draw when not using sprite system. Pass a color to fill (kColorWhite / kColorBlack).

features.name: Set draw color
features.when_to_use: Switch between black, white, clear, XOR before lines/rects/text. Default is black.

features.name: Set dither pattern
features.when_to_use: Fake greys in 1-bit. Atkinson for portraits, Bayer for skies, no Floyd-Steinberg for moving regions.

features.name: Set pattern fill
features.when_to_use: Repeating 8x8 pattern for rect/polygon fills. Use for floors, walls, large backgrounds without per-pixel cost.

features.name: Draw text at point
features.when_to_use: HUD, dialog. Respect cap height minimums (12 dialog, 10 HUD).

features.name: Draw text in rect with alignment
features.when_to_use: Word-wrap dialog, right-align scores, center titles. Use drawTextInRect for multi-line wrap.
features.example_lua: playdate.graphics.drawTextInRect("line of dialog", 8, 180, 384, 56, nil, nil, kTextAlignment.left)

features.name: Load + set custom font
features.when_to_use: Switch fonts per scene. Use the project font tree; never reference Asheville (that's the missing-font fallback).

features.name: Load and draw single image
features.when_to_use: Static art: backgrounds, portraits, title cards. Cached after first load.

features.name: Load imagetable for sprite frames
features.when_to_use: Frame-by-frame animation, tile atlases. File name MUST be name-table-W-H.png. Reference without extension or table suffix.

features.name: AnimationLoop frame iteration
features.when_to_use: Wraps an imagetable in a self-paced animation. Easiest path for looped sprite animation. Pass delay, imagetable, shouldLoop.

features.name: Sprite create + add to display list
features.when_to_use: Anything that moves. Sprites only redraw when moved/invalidated — way cheaper than full-screen redraws. Add to list with :add().

features.name: Sprite move + collision
features.when_to_use: moveWithCollisions returns actual position plus collision list. Use for any sprite that should block against other sprites.
features.example_lua: local x, y, colls = s:moveWithCollisions(nx, ny)

snippets.update_tick:
local nx, ny, colls = state.sprite:moveWithCollisions(state.sprite.x + state.vx, state.sprite.y + state.vy)
    state.colls = colls

features.name: Set clip rect for partial redraw
features.when_to_use: Constrain drawing to a region. Use for HUD overlays that shouldn't redraw the world.

features.name: 2x display scale toggle
features.when_to_use: Chunky 200x120 effective resolution. Trade detail for legibility. Set once in init, not per frame.

features.name: Invert display
features.when_to_use: Flip black/white for accessibility / night mode / damage flash. System-level invert respected by all draws.

features.name: Set refresh rate
features.when_to_use: Default 30. 20 fine for board / dialog. 50 only when motion needs it (curved trajectories) — costs 40% more CPU.

features.name: Draw into an offscreen image
features.when_to_use: Pre-render compound art (combine background + portrait + overlay) once. Push image, draw, pop. Cache result.

snippets.setup:
state.composite = playdate.graphics.image.new(400, 240)
    playdate.graphics.pushContext(state.composite)
    -- draw into composite
    playdate.graphics.popContext()

features.name: Camera offset
features.when_to_use: Scroll the whole world by an offset without moving every sprite. Use for camera follow in side-scroll / top-down.

features.name: Tilemap render
features.when_to_use: Repeating grid art: floors, walls, level geometry. Drive from imagetable + index list. Recommend 32x32 tiles.
features.example_lua: local tm = playdate.graphics.tilemap.new(); tm:setImageTable(it); tm:setTiles(indices, w)

features.name: Gridview list/grid UI widget
features.when_to_use: Standard scrollable list or grid (inventory, dialog choices, level select). Avoids reimplementing scroll math.

snippets.setup:
state.gridview = playdate.ui.gridview.new(0, 28)
    state.gridview:setNumberOfRows(#state.items)
    function state.gridview:drawCell(section, row, column, selected, x, y, w, h)
        if selected then playdate.graphics.fillRect(x,y,w,h) end
        playdate.graphics.drawText(state.items[row], x+4, y+6)
    end

features.name: System menu item
features.when_to_use: Add pause-menu rows (music on/off, restart). Players access via the OS button. Limited to ~3 custom rows.

features.name: Checkmark menu item
features.when_to_use: Toggleable pause-menu row (music on/off, hard mode). Persists checked state.

features.name: Options menu item
features.when_to_use: Pause-menu row with discrete value cycler (font size, difficulty).

features.name: Custom pause-menu image
features.when_to_use: Image shown left of the pause menu. Use it as a second view: inventory, map, stats screen.

features.name: Generate QR code
features.when_to_use: Show long URLs or game-generated data (run code, share link). Pair with text URL fallback.

features.name: Sample player (one-shot wav)
features.when_to_use: Short SFX. Loads sample, calls :play(loops). Cache the sample, not the player, if reused often.

features.name: File player (streaming music)
features.when_to_use: Long looping music. Streams from disk so RAM-light. Set volume; respect save_state.get_music_volume().

snippets.setup:
state.music = playdate.sound.fileplayer.new("music/{SCENE_ID}_theme")
    if state.music then
        state.music:setVolume(save_state.get_music_volume()/10)
        state.music:play(0)
    end

features.name: Synth note
features.when_to_use: Procedural beep/blip/melody when sample assets are overkill. Pass waveform + envelope.

features.name: Microphone input
features.when_to_use: Voice / breath / loudness detection. startListening with a level callback.

features.name: Sound channel with effect
features.when_to_use: Group sources into a channel, apply lowpass/ringmod/bitcrusher. Use for underwater / damage / radio FX.

features.name: Frame-based timer
features.when_to_use: Delay an action by N ms, run a callback. Set timerEndedCallback. Requires CoreLibs/timer + playdate.timer.updateTimers().

features.name: Value-tweening timer
features.when_to_use: Animate a number from A to B over N ms with an easing function. Read .value each frame.

snippets.update_tick:
playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    if state.tween then state.progress = state.tween.value end

features.name: Frame-counting timer
features.when_to_use: Timing in frames rather than ms (consistent across refresh-rate changes). Use for sprite animation cadence.

features.name: Easing function set
features.when_to_use: Pass to value-timer constructors: linear, inOutQuad, outBack, outElastic etc. Avoid linear for organic motion.

features.name: playdate.update hook
features.when_to_use: Required. Called once per frame. Drives all gameplay + sprite updates + timer updates. Single update function per game; scenes route through it.

features.name: gameWillTerminate save hook
features.when_to_use: MANDATORY for any game with save state. Fires when launcher kills the game; flush datastore here.

features.name: deviceWillSleep save hook
features.when_to_use: Fires when device auto-sleeps. Flush save state. Pair with gameWillTerminate.

features.name: gameWillPause hook
features.when_to_use: Fires when player opens the system menu. Pause music, gameplay timers. Pair with gameWillResume.

features.name: Current time milliseconds
features.when_to_use: Monotonic millisecond clock. Use for delta-time computation and RNG seeding.

features.name: Battery level read
features.when_to_use: Show a battery indicator or trigger low-power mode. Returns 0..1.

features.name: Reduce-flashing accessibility flag
features.when_to_use: Respect player Settings preference; skip strobe FX when true. Required for accessibility compliance.

features.name: Datastore read/write
features.when_to_use: Persistent save data. JSON-like table in/out. Slot name keeps multiple stores apart.

features.name: Raw file open
features.when_to_use: Read text-format levels, dialog scripts, CSV data shipped with the pdx. Read-only inside the bundle.

snippets.setup:
local f = playdate.file.open("data/{SCENE_ID}.txt")
    if f then
        state.raw = f:read(1024)
        f:close()
    end

features.name: Geometry point
features.when_to_use: Typed point with arithmetic + distance. Cleaner than raw x,y pairs for vector math.

features.name: Geometry rect + intersection
features.when_to_use: Bounds checking, hotspot detection, collision rects.

features.name: Affine transform
features.when_to_use: Rotate/scale/translate a polygon for procedurally placed art. PRE-render results, do not transform per frame on hot path.

features.name: Geometry polygon
features.when_to_use: Filled or stroked polygon path. Use for level geometry, custom shapes, masks.

features.name: Pathfinder graph + A*
features.when_to_use: A* over a grid or node graph for enemy navigation. Build node list, connect, request path.

features.name: Localized string lookup
features.when_to_use: When intake localization includes >1 language. Lookup key in .strings file matching system locale.

features.name: Read system language
features.when_to_use: Branch dialog or fonts based on user OS language preference.

features.name: HTTP request (network)
features.when_to_use: Server-backed leaderboard / catalog fetch. Wifi only. Bundle a fallback for offline play.

features.name: Console print
features.when_to_use: Standard print() routes to the simulator console / device log. Strip from shipping builds.

features.name: FPS display
features.when_to_use: Draws current FPS in top-left. Dev only; remove for shipping.

features.name: Assertion
features.when_to_use: Lua's standard assert(). Will halt + log on failure. Use for invariants the autopilot is supposed to maintain.
